# Sued for Debt? -- Your Rights & Defenses [2026]
> Being sued for credit card or medical debt? Know your rights, defenses, and how bankruptcy stops lawsuits. 2026 guide.

## About
suedfordebt.org is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.

## Key Pages
- Sued for Debt? -- Your Rights & Defenses: https://suedfordebt.org/
